audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings across both layers say Riposte stuns you — dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, whys[2], spikes[1].text, the early and mid sections, and wants.foe[0].
audit.why: Riot's Riposte text: it slows the first champion hit, 'or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability'. Gangplank's kit contains no immobilise — Powder Keg and Cannon Barrage slow, Parrrley is flat damage — so in this specific matchup Riposte can never produce its stun. Telling the reader to play around a stun that cannot happen makes them refuse trades that are actually available. The real cost of a parried cast is the damage denial plus a slow.
audit.corrected: Every string I rewrote now says Riposte parries the damage and slows, and states explicitly that the stun needs an immobilise you do not have. Also named Lunge's 13s and Grand Challenge's 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call Level 2 even and give Level 3 to Gangplank; the packet chart and the mirror audit both say Level 2 is Fiora and Level 3 is Skill.
audit.why: whys[1] says her level-2 Lunge plus a passive Vital out-trades you before you have a keg pattern and that you should farm at range — that is a Fiora row. whys[2] says neither side cleanly owns the short trade — that is Skill. The Fiora-side page already publishes Level 2 Fiora / Level 3 Skill.
audit.corrected: Level 2 = Fiora, Level 3 = Skill in both layers, with ratings moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes reads 'Fiora: Riposte online, level 6, first item' with no numbers, and phases[4].why never names Grand Challenge.
audit.why: Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s against your Cannon Barrage at 160/140/120s — at level 6 her ultimate cycles far faster than yours, which is why the level-6 row is hers and why Cannon Barrage is a zoning tool here rather than a duel answer.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer ties Grievous Wounds to her healing, and nothing mentions that Lunge applies on-hit effects.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance heals her on every Vital hit and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies when she completes or kills through the Vitals — that is the healing your chip pattern is fighting. Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with attack speed and on-hit items, not just AD.
audit.corrected: Vital healing and anti-heal in dontsFull[1].d; the Grand Challenge team heal in dontsFull[2].d.

notes: packet suspectName 'Her Grand Challenge' is a false positive. Two claims I left alone because the kits do not support them: that Vitals deal percent-max-HP true damage (Riot's passive text says only that hitting a Vital heals her and grants move speed — the damage type is not stated), and the mid-section line that Riposte parrying your cast 'flips the trade' by stunning, which I corrected where the length band allowed but which still survives in the mid paragraph.
